item.text:
Session 3 deliverables are prepared: the [COD schedule](/work/workspace/deliverable/session3/cod_schedule.json), [fresh-start determination](/work/workspace/deliverable/session3/fresh_start.md), and [emergence balance-sheet workpaper](/work/workspace/deliverable/session3/emergence_balance_sheet.md).

The plan discharges **$5.46 million** of the specified claims. The provisional §108 schedule excludes that COD income and reduces the stated $6.1 million NOL to **$640,000**. Fresh-start reporting **does not apply if** the old holders’ 60% interest represents voting shares and the supplied values meet the required test-date measures. Those facts remain unverified.

A reconciled numeric emergence balance sheet cannot be completed from the supplied records. The workpaper shows the supported entries and the missing amounts; [STATUS.md](/work/workspace/deliverable/STATUS.md) records the open items.
